messages:
Alex M.: Heads up — Acme Bank POC needs a compact artifact for procurement: EU-only processing pathway + subprocessors list + KMS options. Deadline EOD Thursday. Can we commit? :alarm_clock:

Jordan L.: Ill make a public-friendly single-page diagram: ingress (EU LB) -> inference pool (EU GPUs) -> ephemeral KV cache -> encrypted artifacts store. Strip internal hostnames.

Priya S.: Flags: KV cache + runtime state stay in EU for EU customers. Telemetry aggregates processed in EU by default; some ops logs forward to vendor endpoints — confirming retention windows and locations.

Sam R.: Metrics batched in eu-west1; alerts to PagerX EU endpoints. Default retention: metrics 30d, debug traces 90d (scrubbed). Ill add vendor links.

Casey W.: KMS options: Redwood-managed keys (eu-west1, default POC), Customer-managed keys (CMK) in EU KMS, Enterprise HSM via partner (enterprise). Note: cross-region backup requires explicit opt-in.

Alex M.: Add "what we redact" note: no raw prompts in support traces; stack-trace hashes; access logged/audited.

Jordan L.: Deliverables: 1) PNG diagram 2) subprocessors.csv (name, purpose, residency, data types, compliance link) 3) 1-pg Q&A.

Priya S.: CSV sample rows: CloudInfraEU, Hosting, eu-west1, compute+storage, SOC2/ISO27001 link; ObsVendorEU, Metrics, eu-west1, aggregated telemetry, retention 30d; AlertVendorEU, Alerting, eu-west*, alerts only, link.

Sam R.: I'll attach evidence links: https://pagervendor.example/eu-locations and metrics SLA.
